node.statement: For t_2:=W.K2*epsilon and epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon, lem-maincb-structural-domain-ledger gives 0<=t_2<=W.r_reset. Moreover lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger gives W.K2>=W.L, hence epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon<=W.K2*epsilon=t_2 because epsilon>=0. Thus the aggregate ledger clause has its base-scale and target-ambient-defect bounds.
